headline: Public hearing on Lofts on Fairgrounds, a 275-unit multi-family development at 132 Fairgrounds Road.
summary: The main item is a proposal for six buildings with 275 residential units. A second project at 74 Main Street would add an accessory structure with two dwelling units, continued from October 27, 2026.
items: Public hearing: Lofts on Fairgrounds, major land development preliminary plan review (comprehensive permit), 132 Fairgrounds Road, Assessor's Plat 21-3, Lot 9
74 Main Street minor land development for an accessory structure with 2 dwelling units, with waivers from landscaping requirements (continued from 10/27/2026)
Report of administrative officer on October 2026 actions: Walmsley Lane and Point Avenue administrative subdivisions, and LaPorte minor subdivision
Designation of duty member for the December 9, 2026 TRC meeting
location: South Kingstown Town Hall, Town Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879

Posted on November 18, 2026 
 
Town of South Kingstown  
Planning Board  
Regular Session Meeting Agenda

180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879

A. Call to Order & Roll Call: 
B. (CA) Approval of Minutes: 
 1. 2026-10-06 PBWS 
 2. 2026-10-27 PBRS 
C. Subdivisions and Land Development Projects: 
 1. PUBLIC HEARING:  Major Land Development, Preliminary Plan Review (Comprehensive Permit) — Lofts on 
Fairgrounds Proposed six (6) building multi-family development with an amenity building at the entrance. 
Each building provides a mixture of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom units for a total of 275 
residential units and associated site improvements. Located at 132 Fairgrounds Road on Assessor's Plat 21-
3, Lot 9. 132 Fairgrounds, LLC, applicant/owner. 
 2. 74 Main Street - Minor Land Development Project to have an accessory structure with 2 dwelling units and 
Unified Development Review for waivers from street and perimeter landscaping requirements in the 
Subdivision & Land Development Regulations. Assessor's Plat 57-1, Lot 78. Owner/Applicant 74 Main Street, 
LLC. (continued from 10/27/2026) 
D. Development Plan Review: None. 
E. Recommendations to Town Council: 
F. Reports and Special Items: 
 1. 2027 Planning Board Meeting Schedule 
G. (CA) Report of Administrative Officer: Actions taken/recorded in October 2026, in accordance with RIGL. 
 1. a. Administrative Subdivision: Walmsley Lane, AP 27-1, Lot 12 & 19-4, Lot 4.  Recorded 10/19/2026. 
b. Administrative Subdivision : Point Avenue, AP 82-4, Lots 28, 29, & 30.  Recorded 10/19/2026. 
c. Minor Subdivision: LaPorte, AP 68-2, Lot 18.  Recorded 10/20/2026. 
H. Designation of Duty Member for Next TRC Meeting: Wednesday, December 9, 2026
